description: This file implements methods for DataElement and LinkedDataElement classes, including CRC32 checksum calculation, buffer access, and data copying functionalities within the WPEFramework Core namespace.

classes.name: DataElement
classes.description: Represents a data element with CRC32 checksum calculation capabilities.

classes.name: LinkedDataElement
classes.description: Represents a linked list of data buffers with methods for buffer management and data copying.

methods.name: DataElement::CRC32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a specified buffer segment.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a segment of the buffer, handling boundary crossing via linked elements.

methods.name: LinkedDataElement::Copy
methods.description: Copies data from another LinkedDataElement into this one, starting at a specified offset.
